[Intro]
[A5]
This will be
your bleak dissolutio-
n. I will rid the
world of your filth.
And I
wi-

ge you
with no re-
morse.

[Verse 1]
[A5]I will a-
bolish all the pain you've caused,
By your pi-

Your horrid fa-
te will not be quick,
Grisly hor-
rors will fall

[Breakdown]
[A5]I
will
make your insides
on the fucking outside.
I'll
tear through your skin
and
watch you rot.

[Bridge]
[A5]

[Verse 2]
[A5]So where's your
pleasure now?
It's not so
pleasing
When you
are the one
At the end of this
misery.
Oh but it
is for me,
To sit and
watch you bleed.
So say your
final prayer,
But I will
promise you,

[Break]
[A5]
God can't show you where
to

[Outro]
[A5]hide.
